content.logline: A seasoned Three Kingdoms general must lead his exhausted troops across a deadly, freezing mountain pass to launch an impossible ambush and lift the siege on a vital allied fortress.

cast.name: General Zhao Yan
cast.profile: A battle-hardened and stoic commander of the Three Kingdoms era, heavily armored and fiercely loyal to his lord.
cast.motivation: To break the siege and save the allied garrison at all costs.
cast.flaw: He pushes his men and himself to the absolute breaking point, often risking total destruction for strategic victory.

cast.name: Lieutenant Feng
cast.profile: A pragmatic, younger officer in the Three Kingdoms army who serves as Zhao Yan's second-in-command and the voice of the exhausted troops.
cast.motivation: To ensure the survival of his men in an impossible campaign.
cast.flaw: His caution borders on defeatism when faced with overwhelming natural obstacles.

locations.name: The Yinping Mountain Pass
locations.description: A perilous, snow-choked gorge in the rugged frontiers of the Three Kingdoms, defined by narrow cliffside trails, blinding whiteout conditions, and sheer drops.

locations.name: The Besieged Fortress of Jincheng
locations.description: A war-torn valley stronghold under heavy assault, its gates splintering and stone walls scarred by siege weapons, surrounded by the vast encampments of a rival kingdom.

story_arc.summary: General Zhao Yan leads his army into a brutal mountain pass to bypass enemy lines, facing immediate resistance from the freezing elements.
story_arc.conflict: The brutal mountain weather rapidly depletes the troops' morale, leading to near-mutiny.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao Yan abandons his command privileges to suffer alongside his men, re-igniting their loyalty.

story_arc.summary: The vanguard discovers the mountain trail has collapsed, leaving only a sheer, terrifying cliff face between them and the valley below.
story_arc.conflict: There is no way back, and descending the cliff seems like certain death for an armored army.
story_arc.turning_point: The general binds his armor with ropes and leads a harrowing free-climb descent.

story_arc.summary: Zhao Yan's surviving forces launch a devastating surprise attack from the unguarded mountain flank, shattering the besieging army.
story_arc.conflict: The allied fortress is moments away from falling to overwhelming enemy forces.
story_arc.turning_point: The sudden, impossible cavalry charge from the mountains breaks the enemy formation, successfully lifting the siege.

scene_outline.goal: To march the army through the treacherous mountain pass despite a blinding snowstorm.
scene_outline.conflict: Lieutenant Feng urges retreat as soldiers begin collapsing from frostbite and exhaustion.
scene_outline.turn: General Zhao Yan casts aside his thick fur cloak, marching exposed in the storm to share the troops' suffering and inspire them forward.

scene_outline.goal: To navigate the final precipice leading down to the besieged valley.
scene_outline.conflict: The trail abruptly ends at a collapsed ravine, halting the advance just as the sounds of the siege echo from below.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao Yan physically hurls his prized weapon over the edge, wraps his hands in torn cloth, and begins scaling down the vertical rock face, prompting the army to follow.

scene_outline.goal: To shatter the enemy siege lines before the fortress gates are breached.
scene_outline.conflict: The besieging army is massive and heavily entrenched around the splintering fortress.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao Yan's forces burst from the obscuring mountain mist, striking the enemy's unprotected flank with overwhelming momentum and routing the siege camp.
